description: Homelab overview: Proxmox host, VMs, ZFS, K3s, Argo CD, IPMI and network.

panels.title: Infrastructure health

targets.expr: (count(up{instance=~"$host"} == 0) or vector(0)) + (count(pve_up{id=~"qemu/.*"} == 0) or vector(0)) + (count(zfs_pool_health > 0) or vector(0)) + (count(smartctl_device_smart_status == 0) or vector(0)) + (count(kube_node_status_condition{condition="Ready",status="true"} == 0) or vector(0)) + (count(argocd_app_info{health_status=~"Degraded|Missing"}) or vector(0))

panels.description: Number of open problems: host down, VMs down, ZFS pool not ONLINE, SMART failing, K8s node NotReady, Argo apps Degraded/Missing. 0 = healthy.

panels.title: Host
panels.description: node_exporter scrape of the Proxmox host

panels.title: ZFS used
panels.description: Fullest ZFS pool

panels.title: VMs up
panels.description: Number of running VMs

panels.title: Power
panels.description: IPMI DCMI power reading, if the BMC supports it

panels.title: CPU 1
panels.description: Package 0. Needs node_cpu_info with the 'package' label.

panels.title: CPU 2
panels.description: Package 1

panels.title: Ambient temp
panels.description: IPMI. Sensor names are selected with the 'ambient_sensors' dashboard variable.

panels.title: CPU temperatures
panels.description: IPMI. Sensor names selected with 'cpu_temp_sensors' variable.

panels.title: Virtual machines

targets.expr: sum by (id,name) (pve_disk_usage_bytes{id=~"qemu/.*"} / pve_disk_size_bytes{id=~"qemu/.*"} * on(id) group_left(name) pve_guest_info)

panels.description: One row per VM (pve-exporter). Disk is only meaningful if the QEMU guest agent reports it.

targets.expr: 100 * sum by (id,name) (pve_memory_usage_bytes{id=~"qemu/.*"} * on(id) group_left(name) pve_guest_info) / sum by (id,name) (pve_memory_size_bytes{id=~"qemu/.*"} * on(id) group_left(name) pve_guest_info)
100 * sum by (id,name) (pve_disk_usage_bytes{id=~"qemu/.*"} / pve_disk_size_bytes{id=~"qemu/.*"} * on(id) group_left(name) pve_guest_info)
